description:
The grid workbenches — a solo studio of benches, each a workspace of
        specimens that tries to make the Relation Grid fail in one way. A bench
        is not a demo: a demo shows the grid working. Registering a bench's
        WorkspaceSpec is the whole registration; the workspace control modal
        switches between every registered kind.

        Bench: Replicating Tables — one editor, any number of read-only
        followers, one persisted store; an edit reaches every table through
        the domain, and no grid is told.

        GridWorkbenchServer runs it on 8083 (-Dworkbench.port=...).
